state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors train a harmless AI assistant through self-improvement without any human labels identifying harmful outputs; the only human oversight is a list of principles (a 'constitution'). A supervised phase fine-tunes on the model's own critiqued and revised responses, and an RL phase trains a preference model on AI judgments of which of two samples is better and uses it as the reward ('RL from AI Feedback', RLAIF), producing a harmless but non-evasive assistant.
title: Constitutional AI: harmless assistant trained from AI feedback, no human harm labels
